elaine_pm: Quick huddle: we're drafting a concise launch checklist for Private v1 packaging. Field asks that differ from earlier threads: explicit IP anchoring guarantees, signed offline bundles, and a visible "compatibility badge" in the UI for each install. Need owners and a soft timeline.

rob_eng: Noted. Proposal: must-haves for v1 = (1) LB/IP anchoring API (re-attach or fail-fast), (2) signed airgap bundle + checksum verification, (3) preflight with remediation hints, (4) documented fast-revert preserving IP claims. Nice-to-have: operator sidecar to perform IP reconciliation.

moh_field: Customers are pushing for two things: a human-readable "install health" badge (green/yellow/red) and an automated preflight report they can hand to their netops. They also want an opt-in maintenance webhook to approve scheduled upgrades.

yara_sre: For upgrades: do rolling operator updates with leader-election pause during critical migrations. Before any upgrade: auto snapshot KV and store locally (or to configured object store). If migration fails, immediately trigger IP-anchoring reconciliation and run rollback script. Target: mean rollback time <25m for common failure modes.

rob_eng: Implementation details: add `ipAnchor` field to the CRD: `ipAnchor: preserve | claim-new | fail`. Signed bundle will be `bundle.tar.sig` that installer verifies with embedded public key. Preflight will produce one-line actions, e.g. "Allow egress to s3.example.net:443 or run --proxy-config".

moh_field: Field note: also document how to run offline snapshot export/import (for airgapped sites) and include a short checklist for netops: firewall rules, routes, and NTP.

yara_sre: CI gating: add a network regression job that spins a k3s cluster, applies CNI variants, verifies ip anchoring across LB recreate, performs upgrade + forced-migration-fail to validate rollback. The job must run nightly on private-packaging branch.

ci-bot: CREATED RW-PRIV-1422: "ip anchoring + signed-bundle + compatibility-badge" assigned to private-packaging squad.

elaine_pm: Owners and dates: rob = ipAnchor API + signed-bundle prototype (EOW); yara = rollback playbook + CI job (next Wed); moh = beta customers + health-badge UX copy (EOD Fri). We'll require 2 beta installs for 14 days with automated probes before GA.

rob_eng: Risk: some load balancers reclaim IPs on service recreation. Mitigation: offer a reconciliation command that calls cloud-provider API or instructs netops steps. For on-prem metal LB we expose a manual claim workflow.

moh_field: Customers want an "audit trail" log for any IP rebind events. let's include that in the runbook and the installer logs.

yara_sre: Also require that snapshots are exportable to tarball for airgapped restores. Add restore validation step post-rollback to check IP bindings and app health.

elaine_pm: Action items recap: rob proto + docs, yara runbook + CI, moh customer lining + UX. I'll update the roadmap doc with these launch gates and mark the epic as "field-critical". Any final asks?

moh_field: Please add a short sample CLI for manual reconcile I'll paste into the field playbook: `redwoodctl reconcile-ip --service demo --lb-ip 198.51.100.22`

rob_eng: will include it. wrapping up 44d"
